MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "An HD Fire TV Stick feels useful because it could add streaming to my Samsung TV alongside my DVD player, provided it is compatible.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my repeated interest in practical accessories that connect existing equipment, though I would check the ports and length before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Fire tablet adds little because I already have a Fire 7, a case and a memory card for it.",
    "Smart speakers and a smart plug introduce uses I have not been seeking; buying power strips does not mean I want voice control or home automation.",
    "The 4K stick's highlighted features offer little benefit for my listed 720p TV, while the portable speaker and Wi-Fi extender address needs I have not expressed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in a broad range of Amazon devices, even though those devices serve different purposes.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been read as a general desire for more gadgets, when many were specific accessories for equipment I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of tripods, memory cards, holders, readers and cables suggest that compatibility and a concrete supporting function matter to me.",
    "My existing equipment matters: a similar tablet would duplicate what I have, and my TV's resolution gives me little reason to seek 4K features.",
    "The two HD streaming sticks represent alternatives for the same need; I would compare them and choose one rather than want both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in useful electronics, but missed how strongly my choices depend on a specific need and compatibility with equipment I already have."
}
